summary: Gray Media filed an 8-K reporting an Eighth Amendment to its Fifth Amended and Restated Senior Credit Facility, dated December 1, 2021, with Wells Fargo as administrative agent. The amendment upsizes Term Loan G, maturing July 15, 2030, by $75 million to $675 million on a delayed-draw basis, with conditions expected satisfied by October 19, 2026. Proceeds, plus cash, fund redemption of the 2029 Notes and related fees. Pricing is Term SOFR plus 3.50% or Base Rate plus 2.50%, with 0.25% quarterly amortization; obligations remain secured by substantially all assets. This is a routine financing/refinancing, not a special situation; watch funding conditions and note-redemption timing.
